data.one_liner: Official Flutter package of Storyly to easily add stories to your app.
data.what_it_does: Adds story and vertical feed experiences to your Flutter application. Supports interactive components like products, ratings, quizzes, and comments.
use_when: You want to integrate Instagram-like stories or vertical video feeds into your Flutter app.
You use the Storyly backend service for managing stories and interactive components.
avoid_when: You need a custom in-house story engine without relying on the Storyly platform.
You are not using the Storyly backend.
strengths: Supports interactive components like quizzes, ratings, and products
Cross-platform support for Android and iOS
weaknesses: Tied to the external Storyly service
License is unknown from available metadata
data.setup_notes: Requires initial SDK setup as documented in Storyly Integration Documentation.
data.minimal_example: // Please check Storyly Integration Documentation for implementation details.
